judgement.question: The elephant striking the tree is carried by a shudder on an empty trunk. Keep the restraint, or show the elephant (one more still, 2)?
The voice names Vinayaka; the screen shows only villagers above the well's rim. Keep this witness treatment?

ep03-vemulavada.hook_seen: Frame one: hands knotting the bull's rope to a stone post as the hook asks why it is tied; the walk with the family follows. Title on frame one, the question as a caption as soon as it fades.
ep03-vemulavada.identity: S03: the temple exterior with families and bulls, cards రాజరాజేశ్వరుడు and రాజన్న (V-EXTERIOR). S06: the Dharma Gundam tank (V-TANK).
ep03-vemulavada.hardest: A devotee and a young bull walking on a slack rope, circling the shrine, then tying the bull (S01, S04, S04b). Animal gait is where clips break most often.
ep03-vemulavada.plan: Three short Kling clips from stills; prompts hold the gait and the slack rope. If a gait breaks, the still holds with a slow push; no retry without approval.

ep04-srikalahasti.hook_seen: Macro: water from a trunk tears the web and a gem rolls; tilt up to the trunk. Title on frame one.
ep04-srikalahasti.identity: S03: the Swarnamukhi and the temple gopurams (S-EXTERIOR), dissolving into the forest.
ep04-srikalahasti.hardest: The snake entering the elephant's trunk and the three deaths (S07, S08).
ep04-srikalahasti.plan: S07 shows the snake rising toward the trunk; the entry and the deaths are carried by the voice; S08 is the tree shuddering, then stillness. Nothing graphic is generated.

ep05-yadagirigutta.hook_seen: The cave mouth from the woman's point of view, torch light flickering; cut before the reveal. Title on frame one.
ep05-yadagirigutta.identity: S02: the hill silhouette; S09: today's black-stone temple on the hill (Y-HILL).
ep05-yadagirigutta.hardest: The five forms of Narasimha at the cave, revealed without drawing any murti (S08, about 15 s).
ep05-yadagirigutta.plan: Villagers' faces lit from inside the cave; each form's name typeset on its own beat. Local animation only.

ep06-kanipakam.hook_seen: Water in a stone well; one ripple. Title on frame one.
ep06-kanipakam.identity: S03: the identified temple exterior with a map card (C-EXTERIOR). No sanctum, no invented murti.
ep06-kanipakam.hardest: Blood from the stone and the brothers healed (S06, S07).
ep06-kanipakam.plan: The tool strikes stone (clip); a restrained red tint spreads in code, not generated blood; then the brothers' faces lift (still).

ep07-puri.hook_seen: A huge painted chariot wheel turning on the road. Title 'పూరీ జగన్నాథుడు · ఒడిశా' on frame one.
ep07-puri.identity: S02/S09: the three chariots on the Bada Danda (P-BADADANDA); S08: the Gundicha temple (P-GUNDICHA).
ep07-puri.hardest: Pahandi: the three carried out of the temple, swaying, without drawing the deities (S04).
ep07-puri.plan: Revised today: servitors seen from behind, ropes rising out of frame, the crowd looking up, cymbals; nothing enters the top of the frame.

ep08-bhadrachalam.hook_seen: Worn temple steps with a lamp, then a prison gate shutting on 'జైలుకెందుకు'. Title on frame one.
ep08-bhadrachalam.identity: S01: the temple steps; S02 and S09: the temple on its hill (new still), both from B-TEMPLE. S10: Golconda fort (G-FORT).
ep08-bhadrachalam.hardest: Rama paying Gopanna's debt, never showing Rama (S11).
ep08-bhadrachalam.plan: Officials in a lamplit treasury turn toward a doorway full of light, coins on the table; card 'భక్తుల కథ ప్రకారం'.
